This is very vulnerable for me to share, but I know this will help someone who is silently struggling. 🤍 Life gets better. I promise. Just 2 months ago, I was still dealing with hormonal acne that had taken over my skin for more than 7 months. It completely shattered my confidence. The acne was incredibly painful and it had gotten to the point where not even makeup could cover it. I avoided mirrors, overthought every photo and didn’t feel like myself anymore. People would tell me, “It’ll get better” and although they meant well, it was so hard to believe them while I was living through it. To some, this might seem like something small. But if you’ve ever struggled with hormonal acne or hormonal imbalances, you know it’s so much more than just your skin. It can affect your confidence, your mental health and the way you see yourself every single day. On top of the hormonal imbalances I was also going through a lot of changes in my personal life which made everything feel even heavier. Looking back now, I’m so grateful I didn’t give up on myself. These past few months have been a beautiful reminder that healing takes time and that there truly is light at the end of the tunnel. If you’re in a season where you’re wondering if things will ever get better, please keep going. Be patient with yourself, give yourself grace and don’t lose hope. Healing isn’t always quick but it is possible. 🤍 #fyp #hormonalacne #acne #hormonalimbalance
